// diagnostic

E0627

This compile-time code reads `{name}`, which is only known at startup

What

This compile-time code reads `{name}`, which is only known at startup

Why

`{name}` could not be folded while building (its value reads the outside world, or computing it failed), so the program computes it at startup, before `fn run`. Compile-time code runs while building, before that value exists.

Fix

Compute the value at runtime instead, or make `{name}` foldable: a pure expression that evaluates without failing.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0627: tests/ui/comptime_reads_startup_constant.stderr.

Error [jet.CompileTimeReadsStartupValue]: This compile-time code reads `GOPHER`, which is only known at startup
  --> tests/ui/comptime_reads_startup_constant.jet:9:21
    |
  9 | TABLE :: comptime { [Int]{GOPHER, 1} }
    |                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `GOPHER` could not be folded while building (its value reads the outside world, or computing it failed), so the program computes it at startup, before `fn run`; compile-time code runs while building, before that value exists
 Fix: Compute the value at runtime instead, or make `GOPHER` foldable: a pure expression that evaluates without failing
